assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina PE), 4T1-luc orthotopic breast tumour tissue, BALB/c mice; HISAT2 to GRCm39, HTSeq read counts, FPKM for display
sample_inclusion: 3 tumours per tumour group sequenced (S2.3.p1); 12 samples total (S3.2.p1); CK (no tumour) group not sequenced
primary_estimand: Effect of daily swimming exercise on breast-tumour gene expression: Tnm_swim vs Tnm (both vehicle gavage); secondary: combination (curcumin + swimming) vs Tnm
planned_contrasts: Tnm_swim vs Tnm (S3.2.p3; paper: 134 DEGs, 79 up / 55 down)
Tnm_union vs Tnm (S3.2.p3; paper: 445 DEGs, 154 up / 291 down)
Tnm_cur vs Tnm (S3.2.p3; paper: 107 DEGs, 28 up / 79 down; non-exercise contrast)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one tumour per independent mouse
normalization: DESeq2 size factors on HTSeq read counts (S2.3.p1; GEO data_processing)
paper_method: DESeq2 pairwise vs Tnm (S2.3.p1); GEO data_processing says DESeq 1.30.0
paper_results: S3.2.p3 counts above; S3.2.p4 union-vs-Tnm KEGG: calcium, Wnt, IL-17 signalling with CAMK1G, WNT5A, IL6
